what: When even one line of the photo box enters the screen, the photo inside settles from 1.1x and transparent to its own size and brightness with a 1s ease (box border stays, once only)

options.[data-fx-part=media]: Inner content that appears as it grows (photo/art cells) — if empty, all direct children
options.margin: How many px earlier (+) or later (−) to turn on from the screen’s bottom edge, default 0 — with % it is a ratio of screen height (-10% is the 90% line)
options.--fx-fade-from: Initial opacity (via style), default 0 — at 1 the opacity is left as is and only the size settles down (brand)
options.--fx-delay: Time until the photo starts settling down (via style), default 0s — time for the slot box to unfold first
options.[data-fx-part=swatch]: Slot box (a child, placed before the photo) — when switched on, a pale surface unfolds from the left to the cell width and lights up, and the photo settles down over it. Without it, just the photo
options.--fx-swatch · --fx-swatch-dur · --fx-swa: Slot box fill, length and curve (via style), default --kf-surface · 1s · cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1)

from.where: news.html News card photo — original store theme use-animate[data-animate=zoom-fade-small] .image-animate, keyframes zoom-fade-small(opacity 0·scale 1.1 → 1) var(--duration-animate) 1s ease forwards, IntersectionObserver rootMargin 0

.js-img collage photos in index.html · about.html · detail.html — original .js-animateimg (TweenLite.fromTo 1.1s Power1.easeInOut alpha 0 · scale 1.1 → 1, plays once when the bottom of the window passes 150px below the element top, visible from the start at 880px and below) — margin: -150; style="--fx-dur: 1.1s; --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955)". The original scaled the whole cell 1.1x (briefly growing past the border) — the part only scales the photo inside the cell

Photo·video slots (.lf-media) in every section — shown once when visible via the original jquery.inview: gray box .js-inview-slide (ani-width 1s cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1) — width 0 → 100%, transparent → opaque), photo .js-inview-fadeInScale (ani-fadeInScale 2s cubic-bezier(.61,1,.88,1) delayed 1s — 1.04×, transparent → in place).
